issue_context.title: AIP-84 Log User Actions / Server Accesses
issue_context.body:
### Body

Similarly to the legacy API, the new FastAPI API should also Log user actions in the `Log` table.


Like the `action_logging` decorator or a Middleware to implement similar behavior.

### Committer

- [X] I acknowledge that I am a maintainer/committer of the Apache Airflow project.
comments: @pierrejeambrun I would like to work on this. Assigned myself cc: @pierrejeambrun

review_comments: This wasn't here before (in the legacy api) but I guess it does not hurt to log that too. 👍
Here you should also add logs checking for `test_post_should_response_201_redacted_password` asserting that the `extra` part has redacted secrets. (password should not appear)
